## Settings › Positions and routing › the Positions box: NEW_1, Save (it goes on Screen A, the first)
  1  GET /api/operator-stations/11/claimed-nodes
  2  PUT /api/operator-stations/11/claimed-nodes
       {
         "nodes": [
           "POS_A1",
           "POS_A2",
           "POS_A3",
           "POS_A4",
           "POS_A5",
           "POS_A6",
           "POS_A7",
           "POS_A8",
           "POS_A9",
           "POS_A10",
           "POS_A11",
           "NEW_1"
         ]
       }
  3  GET /api/process-nodes
  4  GET /api/processes/1/station-counters
  5  GET /api/processes/1/composer?map_rev=map-r1
-- notice: success "Saved"
-- sheet closed

## Settings › Positions and routing › the Positions box: POS_A11 off, Save, and Save again (the impact is read first)

           "POS_A1",

## Settings › Positions and routing on a one-screen Press A: POS_A11 off and Put them on Screen A, Save (the move is not asked about)
  1  GET /api/operator-stations/11/claimed-nodes
  2  POST /api/operator-stations/11/claimed-nodes/impact
       {
         "nodes": [
           "POS_A1",
           "POS_A2",
           "POS_A3",
           "POS_A4",
           "POS_A5",
           "POS_A6",
           "POS_A7",
           "POS_A8",
           "POS_A9",
           "POS_A10",
           "POS_B1",
           "POS_B2",
           "POS_B3",
           "POS_B4",
           "ULD_1"
         ]
       }
  3  PUT /api/operator-stations/11/claimed-nodes
       {
         "nodes": [
           "POS_A1",
           "POS_A2",
           "POS_A3",
           "POS_A4",
           "POS_A5",
           "POS_A6",
           "POS_A7",
           "POS_A8",
           "POS_A9",
           "POS_A10",
           "POS_B1",
           "POS_B2",
           "POS_B3",
           "POS_B4",
           "ULD_1"
         ]
       }
  4  PUT /api/processes/1/positions
       {
         "nodes": []
       }
  5  GET /api/process-nodes
  6  GET /api/processes/1/station-counters
  7  GET /api/processes/1/composer?map_rev=map-r1
-- notice: success "Saved"
-- sheet closed

## Settings › Positions and routing › Loader windows › Make a screen on Press A (LDR_1)
  1  POST /api/loader-boards
       {
         "loader_key": "LDR_1",
         "process_id": 1
       }
  2  GET /api/operator-stations
  3  GET /api/process-nodes
  4  GET /api/processes
  5  GET /api/operator-stations/32/claimed-nodes
-- sheet closed
